verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community comment praising SvelteKit's first-party 'form actions', which points to framework-integrated form handling. There is no first-party documentation in the pack describing form-building modules or how they integrate. Missing for 10: first-party docs for form actions and form building, any evidence of built-in form validation, and documented integration with the rest of the framework (reactivity and load/server flow).

support.subject: As a developer, I can use first-party modules for building and validating forms that integrate with the rest of the framework
